# 5 Star Builders Merchants Ltd

> Local Birmingham builders merchant supplying certified building materials for repair, renovation, and any building work. Trade counter pickup in minutes and same-day delivery across the West Midlands.

## Business Information
- **Name:** 5 Star Builders Merchants Ltd
- **Motto:** "We provide all building stuff. We deliver as well."
- **Physical Depot Address:** 30 Tame Road, Birmingham, England, B6 7DS
- **Telephone (Trade Line):** 0121 7291749
- **Mobile / WhatsApp:** 07397 573929 / +447397573929
- **Email:** info@5starbuildersmerchantsltd.co.uk
- **Website:** https://www.5starbuildersmerchantsltd.co.uk
- **Trade Counter Hours:** Monday – Saturday: 07:00 – 17:30 (Sunday: Closed)
- **Primary Delivery Areas:** Central Birmingham (B1-B99), Aston (B6), Erdington, Sutton Coldfield, Solihull, Walsall, Dudley, and the wider West Midlands.
- **Logistics Capabilities:** Owned commercial fleet equipped with remote HIAB crane offload (direct-to-scaffold and over-the-wall) and express transit vans for same-day job site drops.

## Core Product Lines & Trade Stock
1. **Plumbing & Copper:** BS EN 1057 certified copper tubes (15mm, 22mm, 28mm), end feed, compression, and press fittings, valves, and solder ring joints.
2. **Structural Timber:** C16 and C24 Scandinavian kilned & treated carcassing, roof joists, CLS studwork, roofing battens, OSB3, and marine plywood sheeting.
3. **Electrical Infrastructure:** 18th Edition twin & earth cables, metal clad consumer units, galvanised conduit, cable drums, isolators, and switchgear.
4. **Fascia & Soffit:** Heavy-duty UPVC full-replacement fascia boards, capping boards, vented and hollow soffits in white, anthracite grey, and black ash (5m lengths).
5. **Deepflow Rainwater Guttering:** High capacity commercial and residential rainwater systems, squareline, roundline, deep gutter, matching downpipes, and fittings.
6. **Underground Drainage:** Heavy groundwork grade 110mm and 160mm terracotta sewer pipes, inspection chambers, bottle gullies, non-return valves, and land drainage coils.
7. **Plasterboard & Drylining:** Fireline pink boards, Soundshield blue acoustic drywall, moisture-resistant green boards, standard square and tapered edge 12.5mm / 15mm sheets.
8. **Bonding & Plasters:** British Gypsum Thistle Multi-Finish, Scheme Bonding Coat, Hardwall, Dri-Wall adhesive, corner beads, scrim tape, and pre-grit.
